Capabilities Explorer

One team from drawing
to final install.

Tap through the three disciplines. Empire handles design engineering, fabrication, and installation under one roof — so tolerances, finishes, and schedules don’t get lost between shops.

Representative photo

Design Engineering

Shop drawings, engineering, and detailing for ornamental metals, storefronts, railings, structural glazing, and curtain walls — coordinated before a single piece is cut.

    Best first step: bring drawings, a sketch, or just the opening sizes — confirm scope by phone at (718) 321-1697.

    Services

    What Empire builds.

    Five core scopes, all designed, fabricated, and installed by Empire’s own people. Pricing and scope are confirmed by phone — every job is custom.

    The Shop · College Point

    A trade handed down,
    not handed off.

    Empire’s work is done by second- and third-generation tradesmen — more than 100 employees across several unions, working out of two facilities in College Point, including one dedicated specifically to glass. That continuity is why client relationships here are measured in decades: 25 years and counting.
